Method of Attack: Password cracking tool capable of compromising protected computers by decrypting login credentials such as passwords
Used to obtain login credentials of tens of thousands of computers worldwide
Used by threat actors linked to multiple Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operations including REvil, Dharma, and Netwalker to brute force Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) servers and compromise networks
Attack Vector: Brute forcing login credentials via NLBrute malware
Indicators of Compromise: Stolen credentials sold on dark web marketplaces
Login information of a law firm in the Middle District of Florida sold to undercover law enforcement
Use in ransomware and tax fraud campaigns
